title: Langevin Monte-Carlo Provably Learns Depth Two Neural Nets at Any Size and Data
abstract: arXiv:2503.10428v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this note we prove that the Langevin Monte Carlo (LMC) algorithm can minimize the population risk of appropriately regularized depth-2 nets with no restrictions on the size of the net and for any choice of training data --- and we give non-asymptotic convergence rates for it. We achieve this via showing that in q-Renyi divergence, the iterates of LMC converge to the Gibbs distribution of certain Frobenius norm regularized losses for these nets --- in both classification and regression settings. The key technicality of the work is two-fold (a) to keep the amount of regularization needed be independent of the size of the net and (b) to obtain convergence rates that scale with just the Poincare constant of the corresponding Gibbs measure. translated_title: 朗之万蒙特卡洛方法可在任意网络规模和任意数据下可证明地学习两层神经网络
translated_abstract: 在这篇笔记中，我们证明了朗之万蒙特卡洛算法能够最小化经过适当正则化的深度为2的神经网络的总体风险，且对网络的规模没有任何限制，也适用于任意选择的训练数据——并给出了其非渐近收敛速率。我们通过证明在q-Rényi散度下，LMC的迭代过程收敛到这些网络的某种Frobenius范数正则化损失所对应的吉布斯分布来实现这一点——这在分类和回归两种设置中均成立。本工作的关键技术要点有两个：（a）使所需的正则化量与网络的规模无关，（b）获得的收敛速率仅取决于相应吉布斯测度的Poincaré常数。这项工作综合了近期的若干观察结果，包括LMC收敛所需的等周条件，以及两层神经网络的损失函数总可以通过常数大小的正则化来处理。
tldr: 本文证明了朗之万蒙特卡洛算法在任意网络规模和任意训练数据下都能可证明地收敛并学习两层神经网络，所需正则化量与网络规模无关，收敛速率仅取决于Poincaré常数。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that Langevin Monte Carlo provably learns depth-two neural networks at any size and for any training data, with regularization independent of network size and non-asymptotic convergence rates depending only on the Poincare constant.
